confound_stated: The selection's measured object is the review loop of the sealed candidate-recovery control arm, which also changed the Planner's routing text, the Solver's instruction and the candidate proposal. This cell moves the Reviewer instruction ALONE (the brief scopes the optimisation to the node); the Planner keeps the locked routing text and the Solver the locked revision clause. The transfer is therefore an assumption stated here and tested by the read: the arm's own per-visit credit (REVISE rate per class, helped / hurt per revision, the entity-error delta on CORRECT drafts) is compared with the source arm's sealed credit, and a loop value far below the source's is read as 'the lift lived in the Planner / Solver texts', which names the next round's node.
expectation_arithmetic: Measured, never a prior (decision 139): on the SAME 625 TRAIN R01C rows (outside Fold A), the contrastive form's review loop moved intent by +2.56 pp over its own first drafts and the locked form's by +0.738 pp (mean of 11 sealed pools); paired per row the difference is +1.697 pp CI95 [+0.263, +3.143] (whole-utterance cluster bootstrap, 2000 draws, seed 20260927). A review loop can only act on a wrong draft, so the transfer to the base scales by the first-draft intent-wrong rate: R01C 1920/6399 = 30.00 % under the locked form, the base 14.17 % (the sealed AGREE arm's official intent 85.83, docs/results/2026-09-27-slurp-agree-w1-fold-a-read.md). Expected intent effect 1.697 x 0.1417 / 0.3000 = +0.80 pp (interval +0.12 to +1.48), BELOW the cross-flight benefit bar of about 2.5 pp at n = 1,080 and below the intent own-null half-width 0.9943: the design cannot see it as a gain, so the cell claims none and is admitted on NO HARM; the node's own within-trajectory loop value is read beside it.

no_harm_rule: NO-HARM ADMITTED (owner decision 127): against the IN-CHAIN A/A arm flown in the same chain, the paired CI95 lower bound of the intent-accuracy delta (primary, decision 133) is not below -0.9943 pp AND the paired CI95 lower bound of the official pooled SLU-F1 delta (the guard) is not below -1.2485 pp -- each metric at its own Fold A own-null half-width (docs/readiness/2026-09-26-slurp-stage3-measurement-instrument-v1.md section 2d). HARMFUL: a measured loss on either metric (CI95 upper bound below zero, decision 25). NEUTRAL-BY-WIDTH IS THE ADMISSION. The cell is NEVER reported as a gain, whatever the point estimate. Beside the verdict, never instead of it, the read reports the NODE CREDIT: on each arm, the loop value (delivered answer minus the same trajectory's first Solver draft, intent and official pooled SLU-F1, paired within the flight, cluster CI95) and the per-visit credit table by pre-review error class computed by scripts/analysis/slurp_reviewer_credit_table.py's own functions; the arm-minus-A/A difference of loop values set beside the declared expectation +0.80 pp; the Reviewer contact rate and REVISE rate; the per-scenario table in both weightings and the frontier row (decision 75); and a model-free count of Reviewer responses narrating a tool call on each arm.

offline_selection.reading: No gate and no revision scope over the sealed revisions beat honouring every revision: the cross-fitted choices returned 0.000 / 0.000 (contrastive) and -0.024 / -0.18 intent (locked) on their held-out folds. The node's existing revisions are net useful on intent; its deficit is REACH. The offline loop therefore selects on the one policy dimension where a sealed alternative exists -- the Reviewer's form -- and leaves gating and scope as they are.
